value.$comment: Missing original fields may be null/empty only under closed UNRESOLVED execution with nonempty reason and not_measured disposition. Known original facts remain unchanged. Current REQUIRED cells remain required before any missing-field filter. CONFIGURED retains the entire original profile/platform/runtime contract. authority_link remains C of an original selected JSON value; TOML/YAML bytes cannot be substituted. configuration_authority permits the existing exact candidate_source_blob byte branch as a distinct source kind, with closed field-specific trusted replay; it does not convert raw YAML/TOML into JSON authority or permit an arbitrary source/configuration override.

Explicit empty mapping arrays are representable only for UNRESOLVED implementation. They confer no coverage. Determine current applicability from complete authoritative BOM/owner/first-required release before inspecting mappings; retain a blocker per missing dimension and prohibit dependent unit/coverage materialization. CONFIGURED requires every mapping nonempty.

Empty environment_pairs or covers_stages preserve a missing original mapping only with a nonempty existing UNRESOLVED coverage reason and never a CONFIGURED leaf. They are not wildcards or zero-cell/zero-stage success. Select current applicability before emptiness; emit an exact blocker per missing field and prohibit dependent units/coverage. Preserve every original known stage/pair mapping.
